# d2r-mobile-architecture.md — code and data map (HarmonyOS view)

## 1. One picture

```
player's Switch files (Update/ExeFS main,sdk + RomFS data)          [player's PC, never in git]
  └─ dm/tools/d2rm_android.py --target ohos  → import pack  dm/{out,shaders,overlay,ui-art,derived.tsv,pack_info.txt}
       ├─ dm/tools/patch_nso.py (DM_TARGET=ohos)  rewrites main/sdk/subsdk0 → out/
       └─ shader translation (dmsh chain → SPIR-V)                → shaders/
HAP (dm/harmony/app, ArkTS shell + libdm.so)  ── user picks "D2R Mobile/{data,dm}" ──▶ copied into app sandbox files/dm
  libdm.so = dm/harmony/native (N-API, front, touch) + dm/host (Horizon host) + dm/gfx/vulkan (NVN→Vulkan)
           + dm/android/{vulkan_present,overlay_validate,compat} through native/android_shim
  └─ XComponent surface (VK_OHOS_surface) → screen;  touch → dm/ios/Sources/dm_touch_controls.c state machine
```

## 2. Module inventory

| Path | Responsible for | Not responsible for | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dm/harmony/app/` | hvigor project: ArkTS shell (XComponent, lifecycle, folder import, form card, backup ext) | Game logic, rendering | upstream | active; `deviceTypes: ["phone"]` only, touch-only input (2026-10-26) |
| `dm/harmony/native/` | `libdm.so` N-API: start-up, HarmonyOS defaults (`napi_ohos.c`), front, touch, Game Service Kit perf | Shared host / gfx | upstream | active |
| `dm/harmony/native/android_shim/` | Maps the few Android NDK calls of reused files to HarmonyOS (`OHNativeWindow`, `VK_OHOS_surface`, hilog) | — | upstream | active |
| `dm/harmony/probe/` | TLS slot layout probe (`tpidr_el0 − 272`) used by `DM_TARGET=ohos` | — | upstream | re-run per new device / firmware |
| `dm/harmony/tools/gen_strings.py` | `dm/i18n/ui_text.tsv` → `ets/generated/UiText.ts` | — | upstream | output stale on 2026-10-26 (issue 008) |
| `dm/host/` | Horizon OS host: syscalls, FS, audio, input, game features | — | upstream | shared |
| `dm/host/app_mac.m` | macOS app: keyboard / mouse / controller mapping | — | upstream | **reference** for PC input (issue 005) |
| `dm/gfx/vulkan/` | NVN → Vulkan graphics layer (shared with Android) | — | upstream | shared |
| `dm/android/` | Android shell; files reused by HarmonyOS via the shim | — | upstream | shared |
| `dm/tools/`, `setup.sh` | Rewriter, import-pack tool, workspace setup | — | upstream | shared |
| `docs/`, `tools/dev/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (ours, see ADR-0001) | This fork's doc surface and gate | Player docs | ours | active |

## 3. Data and artifacts

| Name | Source | Lands at | Regenerable | In git |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Switch game files 1.0.34.0 | The player's own console dump | Player's PC (path TBD, issue 003) | no | **never** |
| Workspace `$DM_ROOT` | `./setup.sh` | `~/dm-work` (default) | yes | no |
| HarmonyOS import pack | `d2rm_android.py --target ohos` | `<out>/harmony/dm` | yes | **never** |
| HAP (unsigned / signed) | hvigor via `oh build`, `oh pkg sign` | `dm/harmony/app/entry/build/...` | yes | no (`*.hap` ignored) |
| Signing material (cert, profile, keystore) | AGC / `oh auth` / `harmonyos-atd-provision` | `/private/` or outside repo | partly | **never** |
| Saves | The game, in the app sandbox | device | **no** | never |

Size: import pack + data + in-app copy ≈ 17.4 GB on the device `(upstream-reported, Mate 90 Pro Max)`.

## 4. Command surface

| Command | Does | Output | Typical duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `python3 tools/dev/check_docs.py --tier 2` | Doc gate | stdout, exit 1 on fail | ~2 s |
| `python3 dm/i18n/scan_literals.py` · `python3 dm/ios/tools/dm_i18n.py --check` | String-table gates | stdout | ~2 s |
| `./setup.sh` / `./setup.sh check` | Prepare workspace from game files (Python env, rewrite, shaders) | `$DM_ROOT` | unmeasured here (issue 003) |
| `python3 -X utf8 -B dm/tools/d2rm_android.py --target ohos <Update> <out>` | Build the HarmonyOS import pack | `<out>/harmony/dm` | unmeasured here (issue 003) |
| `oh build …` in `dm/harmony/app` | Build the HAP on this VM | `entry/build/default/outputs/...` | unmeasured — exact line is issue 002's deliverable |
| `oh pkg sign` · `oh app install` · `oh ability start` · `oh log` · `oh perf` | Sign / install / launch / observe on device | device | — |

## 5. External dependencies and version pins

| Dependency | Version / coordinates | Why it is pinned |
|---|---|---|
| Upstream | `jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile` @ `195ae11` (fork point, 2026-10-26) | Sync point; record each merge here |
| Game build | Switch 1.0.34.0 = PC 3.3.94012; `dm/PRODUCT` = `3.3.94012-r44` | Rewriter cuts / addresses are per build |
| HarmonyOS SDK | API 26 (`targetSdkVersion` / `compatibleSdkVersion` 26.0.0 in `build-profile.template.json5`) | HAP refuses to install below API 26 |
| Toolchain | Native linux-arm64 Command Line Tools on oh-vm (skill `vm-openeuler`) | Only toolchain on this host |
| Shader tools | `spirv-opt` (with `--trim-capabilities`), `spirv-val`, `glslc`, .NET SDK | Import-pack generation |

## 6. Known gaps

| Gap | Impact | Tracked at |
|---|---|---|
| `module.json5` declares `phone` only | HAP will not install on the PC (`2in1`) | `docs/issues/004` |
| ArkTS shell handles touch only | No keyboard / mouse / gamepad on any HarmonyOS device | `docs/issues/005`, `006` |
| No HAP build verified on this host | Every `dm/harmony` change is unbuildable-unverified | `docs/issues/002` |
| `UiText.ts` stale vs `ui_text.tsv`, no drift gate | Shell shows old / missing strings | `docs/issues/008` |
| Mate X5 API level unknown | Phone target may be unreachable as-is | `docs/issues/007` |
